label: Seeker Missile
note: IP-neutral. Needs a lock: keep the target in the cone for lock_time seconds. A rack of four (mag): holding the key with a lock fires them off one every rate seconds, and the lock holds through the salvo (AI pilots lock afresh for each). reload_each: one seeker comes back every 1.5 s while the rack is short (reload_time is unused then). In a space fight its speed and ranges are scaled (content/core/flow/space_fight.json).
